## Summary of Changes

Provide a brief summary of what this PR does and why it was introduced.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to
      change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Backend tests pass locally (`cd API && mvn clean test`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with no TypeScript errors
      (`cd Website && npm run build`)
- [ ] Manual verification in browser performed
